law.catch_line: Interpreters; recording testimony of deaf witness (Supreme Court Rule 2:604 derived from this section)
law.text: Interpreters shall be sworn truly so to do. In any judicial proceeding, the judge on his own motion or on the motion of a party to the proceeding may order all of the testimony of a deaf individual and the interpretation thereof to be visually electronically recorded for use in verification of the official transcript of the proceedings.
